data.value: SELECT InsuredContactGUID, InsuredLocationGUID, DeliveryMethodID, FName, LName, Title, Phone, Extension, Cell, Email, Salutation, RmNumber, StatusID, Address1, Address2, City, County, State, ZipCode, ZipPlus, Fax, LName + ', ' + FName AS Name, Region, ISOCountryCode, OptOut FROM tblInsuredContacts WHERE (InsuredLocationGUID = @InsuredLocationGuid)
